basic_info.description: Tucked away in San Francisco's beloved Inner Sunset, this spacious 1 bedroom / 1 bath home blends classic San Francisco charm with true city convenience. Featuring an ideal floor plan with timeless details like crown molding and hardwood floors as well as skylights that brighten the interiors and windows that frame views of Mount Sutro & Sutro Tower. As you enter, a formal entry greets you flanked by a charming dining room which flows into the kitchen and an oversized living room ideal for entertaining.   The expansive and bright bedroom looks out to the private backyard sanctuary with a lush garden and deck. A mudroom and three additional closets provide practicality and comfort while a generous garage with internal access provides secure parking, abundant storage, and a dedicated laundry area. The long driveway provides a dedicated second parking space. With easy Muni access and a friendly neighborhood feel, this home captures the very best of San Francisco living. A sweet city gem - this home is a rare blend of charm, comfort and accessibility. Second level may be possible - buyers to verify.
